name: windup-monitor
description: Windup Monitor — self-hosted monitoring with deterministic recovery. Monorepo: core (Fastify/TS), web (Vite/React), agent (Go).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace core && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace core && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace core && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace core && npm run build --workspace web
